result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the promotional banner has low-contrast text that is hard to read against its pale green background.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, both the heading and the subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are rendered in very light text on a pale green background, giving poor contrast and making the offer difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner heading and subtitle (or deepen the banner background) so both lines meet WCAG contrast guidelines and remain legible.
